name: Pilha
title: One Who Sealed the Covenant
summary: Pilha is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as one of the leaders among the people who placed their seal on the covenant with God after returning from the Babylonian exile. He was among those who committed themselves to follow God's law and remain separate from the surrounding nations. Beyond this act of sealing, little is known about his life.

keyEvents.title: Sealing of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Pilha was one of the leaders among the people who placed their seal on the written covenant to follow God's law, as Nehemiah organized it.

keyEvents.title: The People's Commitment to God's Law
keyEvents.description: Together with others who sealed the covenant, Pilha committed himself to walk according to God's law given through Moses and to keep all the Lord's commands and statutes.

keyEvents.title: Promise to Remain Separate
keyEvents.description: Those who sealed the covenant, including Pilha, promised not to give their daughters in marriage to the foreign peoples of the land or take their daughters as wives for their sons.

keyEvents.title: Commitment to Sabbath Observance
keyEvents.description: Pilha and the others committed themselves to keep the Sabbath holy and not to buy goods from foreign peoples on the Sabbath day or other holy days.
